name: CCNU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free accommodation, monthly stipend and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC standards.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health with good academic records. Bachelor applicants need high school graduation, master applicants a bachelor degree, and doctoral applicants a master degree.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC system at campuschina.org and submit the CCNU online application with supporting documents. Follow the Application Procedures page for review and admission steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) at CCNU

scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language and culture study at CCNU. Applicants should meet the language program entry requirements and be in good health.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and complete the CCNU online application. Select CCNU as host university and upload required documents.
scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at CCNU

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted international degree students at CCNU. Applicants should have excellent academic records and meet program language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CCNU international student online application system and indicate interest in the new-student scholarship. The university reviews admission materials to award the scholarship.
scholarships.title: CCNU Scholarship for New Students

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught: 16,000-19,000 RMB/year (Liberal Arts 16,000; Science 17,500; Music/Fine Arts/PE 19,000).
Graduate Chinese-taught: 19,700-24,500 RMB/year; Doctorate: 24,000-34,000 RMB/year.
English-taught Bachelor (e.g. International Trade, Business Administration): 22,000 RMB/year.
English-taught Master: 25,700-28,000 RMB/year; English-taught PhD: 30,000-38,500 RMB/year.
Chinese Language Program: about 15,000 RMB/year. See the official admissions page for the current fee structure.

name: WHUT

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver and free accommodation; monthly stipend and medical insurance per CSC standards.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with good health and good academic records equivalent to Chinese high school for bachelor or bachelor degree for postgraduate study. Applicants must meet language requirements (HSK 4+ for Chinese-taught, TOEFL 80+/IELTS 6.0+ for English-taught).
scholarships.instructions: Apply to the dispatching authority (usually the Chinese Embassy) via campuschina.org for CSC, and complete the WUT online application at admission.whut.edu.cn. Check admission results by email or the application system.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at WHUT

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted international students at WHUT. Applicants should have excellent academic performance and meet program entry and language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the WUT online application at admission.whut.edu.cn within the application period (Oct 10, 2025 to June 30, 2026 for self-sponsored). The university evaluates materials for the Friendship Scholarship.
scholarships.title: WUT Friendship Scholarship

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation and stipend per MOFCOM standards for eligible postgraduate students.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese postgraduate applicants meeting MOFCOM scholarship requirements. Applicants should hold a bachelor degree for master or master degree for doctoral study and be in good health.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the MOFCOM/CSC channels and complete the WUT online application. See the WUT Scholarship pages and admission.whut.edu.cn for details.
scholarships.title: MOFCOM Scholarship at WHUT

tuition_info:
Bachelor: Science & Engineering Chinese 20,000 / English 24,000 RMB/year; Economics/Management/Liberal Arts Chinese 18,000 / English 20,000 RMB/year; Fine Arts Chinese 25,000 / English 30,000 RMB/year.
Master: Science & Engineering Chinese 26,000 / English 30,000 RMB/year; Economics/Management/Liberal Arts Chinese 23,000 / English 27,000 RMB/year; Fine Arts 33,000 / 38,000 RMB/year; MBA 30,000 / 34,000 RMB/year.
Chinese Language program: 17,000 RMB/year; Pre-university program: 23,000 RMB/year.
Application fee: 500 RMB; on-campus double-room dormitory: 8,400 RMB/year per person.

name: HZAU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free university accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance; stipend Master 3,000 RMB/month, Doctoral 3,500 RMB/month.
documents: Two recommendation letters by professors/associate professors
Physical Examination Record and non-criminal record certificate
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health. Master applicants must hold a bachelor degree and be under 35; doctoral applicants must hold a master degree and be under 40. HSK 5+ for Chinese-medium or recognized English test for English-medium programs.
scholarships.instructions: Apply at studyinchina.csc.edu.cn (HZAU agency number 10504) from Nov 1, 2025 to Feb 27, 2026, and complete the HZAU application at hzau.at0086.cn/student. Upload all required documents to both systems.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at HZAU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free university accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance; stipend Master 2,100 RMB/month, Doctoral 2,500 RMB/month.
documents: Acceptance letter from HZAU professor if available
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent non-Chinese Master and Doctoral applicants for HZAU programs. Applicants must meet degree, age and language requirements and demonstrate strong academic background.
scholarships.instructions: Apply at hzau.at0086.cn/student from Nov 1, 2025 to Feb 27, 2026. The university reviews materials and selects recipients for the HZAU Scholarship.
scholarships.title: Huazhong Agricultural University Scholarship

tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Science & Engineering 16,000 RMB/year; Economics/Management/Humanities & Social Sciences 14,000 RMB/year.
Master: Science & Engineering Chinese 25,000 / English 28,000 RMB/year; Economics/Management/Humanities Chinese 22,000 / English 25,000 RMB/year.
Doctor: Science & Engineering Chinese 40,000 / English 44,000 RMB/year; Economics/Management/Humanities Chinese 28,000 / English 32,000 RMB/year.
Chinese Language Program: 13,000 RMB/academic year (6,500/semester); Accommodation single 10,000 / double 5,000 RMB/year; Registration 400; Insurance 800 RMB/year.

name: ZUEL

scholarships.amount_text: Type A: tuition free, free double-room accommodation (750 RMB/month standard), living allowance 2,500 RMB/month, medical insurance 800 RMB/year. Type B/C with reduced coverage; supports first year of study.
documents: HSK 5+ for Chinese-taught or IELTS 6.0+/TOEFL 80+ for English-taught
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with valid passport and no criminal record. Bachelor applicants need HSK 5+ and good high school records; graduate Chinese-taught need HSK 5+ and GPA 3.0+; graduate English-taught need IELTS 6+/TOEFL 80+ and GPA 3.0+.
scholarships.instructions: Register at iesmis.zuel.edu.cn/member/login.do, choose International Students Scholarship, complete information and upload documents. Only one major per applicant; results are announced on the IES website.
scholarships.title: Study in ZUEL Freshman Scholarship

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance per CSC program standards (Bilateral, High Level Postgraduate, Silk Road, Belt and Road IP Law).
documents: Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CSC and ZUEL program requirements. Applicants should have strong academics and meet degree, age and language criteria for the chosen CSC track.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via campuschina.org under the relevant CSC track with ZUEL as choice, and complete the ZUEL online application at iesmis.zuel.edu.cn. Follow the IES admission guide for review steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at ZUEL

scholarships.eligibility: International students pursuing Chinese language teacher-related study at ZUEL. Applicants should meet language and academic requirements for the program.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and complete the ZUEL online application. Select ZUEL as host university.
scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at ZUEL

tuition_info:
Bachelor Chinese-taught: 16,000 RMB/year; Doctoral Chinese-taught: 24,000 RMB/year; Doctoral English-taught: 34,000 RMB/year.
General Scholar (incl. Chinese Language): 16,000 RMB/year; Senior Scholar: 20,000 RMB/year; Experience Chinese online courses: 2,500 RMB/program.
Application fee: 500 RMB; Accommodation double 750 / single 1,350 RMB per person per month; medical insurance required.
Master tuition varies by program; see the official 2026 Admission Guide for International Students.

name: Sichuan University

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation subsidy, medical insurance and living expenses per CSC standards. SCU Overseas Students Office reviews jointly with CSC.
documents: Passport first page and visa/residence page if in China
Highest academic certificate or pre-graduation certificate
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting SCU degree and language requirements (e.g. HSK 5 180+ for Chinese-taught undergrad, TOEFL 80+/IELTS 6.0+ for English-taught). Applicants must meet age, health and conduct requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Follow campuschina.org requirements and submit SCU documents via the SCU Overseas Students Office site. Postgraduate and non-degree applications run Nov 1, 2025 to May 30, 2026; undergraduate Jan 1 to May 30, 2026.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at SCU

scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation subsidy, medical insurance and living expenses: master up to 2,000 RMB/month, doctoral up to 3,000 RMB/month.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international Master and Doctoral applicants to SCU majors (all majors open). Selection is based on academics, language proficiency, research potential and personal qualities with annual review.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SCU International Student Application System at scu.17gz.org/member/login.do within the program period. Scholarship recipients are selected by the SCU Scholarship Review Committee.
scholarships.title: Study at SCU Outstanding Student Scholarship (Postgraduate)

scholarships.amount_text: Partial scholarship up to 20,000 RMB/year for undergraduate students (excluding Clinical Medicine and Stomatology). Tuition and insurance must be paid first each term.
documents: Financial proof of at least 5,000 USD unless full scholarship
Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international undergraduate applicants to SCU. Applicants need good high school records, required CSCA subjects, and HSK 5 180+ for Chinese-taught or TOEFL 80+/IELTS 6.0+ for English-taught majors.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SCU International Student Application System from Jan 1 to May 30, 2026. Apply early since scholarship spots are limited.
scholarships.title: Study at SCU Outstanding Student Scholarship (Undergraduate)

tuition_info:
Chinese Language Program: 8,250 RMB/semester; Registration fee: 600 RMB.
Undergraduate, Master and Doctoral degree tuition varies by major and teaching language; see the official SCU Overseas Students Office program directories.
Application fee: 600 RMB (also required for scholarship applications); insurance and accommodation paid per university rules.

name: UESTC

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance per CSC standards for eligible degree students.
documents: Two academic recommendation letters for graduate students
Foreigner Physical Examination Form or visa page
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health with good morals and discipline. Applicants must meet degree requirements (high school for bachelor, bachelor for master, master for PhD) and language requirements with CSCA report for undergraduates.
scholarships.instructions: Register at admission.uestc.edu.cn, fill the form, upload documents and pay the application fee before the deadline (Graduate Dec 1 to Mar 1; Undergraduate Dec 1 to June 30). Also apply via campuschina.org for CSC.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at UESTC

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students newly admitted to UESTC. Selection considers academic merit, language proficiency and overall performance.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the UESTC online application system at admission.uestc.edu.cn. Scholarship review follows academic review of admission materials.
scholarships.title: UESTC University Scholarship for International Students

scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students at UESTC meeting Chengdu Government Scholarship criteria. Applicants should have strong academics and good conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the UESTC admission system and follow Chengdu Government Scholarship notices. Results are announced via the UESTC admission platform.
scholarships.title: Chengdu Government Scholarship at UESTC

tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Chinese-taught 15,000 RMB/year (Clinical Medicine 45,000; Nursing 33,000); English-taught 20,000 RMB/year.
Master: Chinese- or English-taught 25,000 RMB/year; PhD: Chinese- or English-taught 34,000 RMB/year.
Chinese Language: 12,500 RMB/semester; Pre-University: 12,500 RMB/semester; Application fee 420 RMB.
Dormitory double 6,000 / quad 3,000 RMB/year; Medical insurance 1,000 RMB/year; Residence permit 400 RMB/year.

name: SWJTU

scholarships.amount_text: Free tuition and insurance; monthly stipend Bachelor 2,500 / Master 3,000 / PhD 3,500 RMB; accommodation Bachelor 700 / Master 700 / PhD 1,000 RMB/month. SWJTU code 10613, Type B.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding young international students for graduate and doctoral study at SWJTU under the Chinese University Program. Applicants must meet degree, health and conduct requirements for postgraduate study.
scholarships.instructions: Apply for the Chinese University Program Type B with SWJTU (10613) via campuschina.org and complete the SWJTU application. Follow the CSC Scholarship notice on the SWJTU site.
scholarships.title: CSC Chinese University Program at SWJTU

scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students studying at SWJTU. The President Scholarship was established in 2012 to encourage international study at SWJTU.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SWJTU international admission system and follow the SWJTU Presidential Scholarship notice. The university evaluates admission materials for awards.
scholarships.title: SWJTU Presidential Scholarship

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students at SWJTU meeting Chengdu Government Scholarship requirements. Applicants should demonstrate good academics and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through SWJTU following the Chengdu Government Scholarship application notice. Submit materials via the SWJTU admission system.
scholarships.title: Chengdu Government Scholarship at SWJTU

tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Humanities/Management 17,000; Science & Engineering 22,000; Art Design/Architecture 24,000 RMB/year.
Master: Humanities/Management 21,000; Science & Engineering 24,000; Art/Architecture 25,000 RMB/year; Doctoral: from 25,000 RMB/year.
Language students: 15,500 RMB/year; English-taught courses typically 20-30% higher; application fee 600 RMB.
See the official SWJTU Fees & Fundings pages for the current program rates.

name: SUFE

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance per CSC standards for eligible degree students at SUFE.
documents: High school diploma and full transcripts
English proficiency IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 / Duolingo 100 or proof of English-medium schooling
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens aged 18-45 in good health with senior high school education. English-taught applicants need IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, Duolingo 100+ unless native speakers, plus CSCA Math test.
scholarships.instructions: Take the CSCA Math test, remit the 830 RMB application fee by bank transfer, then register and apply at ao.sufe.edu.cn from May 10 to June 25, 2026. Shortlisted students attend an interview; decisions appear in the Applicant Portal.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at SUFE

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international degree students at SUFE. Applicants should meet program academic and language requirements and demonstrate strong overall merit.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SUFE Applicant Portal at ao.sufe.edu.cn and follow the Undergraduate or Graduate Programs Scholarships pages. The university reviews admission applications for awards.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at SUFE

tuition_info:
Undergraduate English-taught Finance: 15,000 RMB/semester, 30,000 RMB/year; Duration 4 years.
Other undergraduate, master and doctoral tuition varies by program and teaching language; see the official SUFE program pages.
Application fee: 830 RMB/person (bank transfer only); CSCA test required; admission documents sent in late July.

name: CDUT

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance per CSC standards.
documents: Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health meeting CDUT degree requirements. Bachelor applicants need high school graduation, master applicants a bachelor degree, and doctoral applicants a master degree.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via campuschina.org for CSC and complete the CDUT online application at cdut.at0086.cn. Upload documents and follow the CDUT Enrollment Guide for International Students.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at CDUT

scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students at CDUT. The Sister Cities scholarship supports students from partner cities with strong academics and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CDUT international application system following the annual scholarship notice. The university evaluates admission materials for awards.
scholarships.title: Chengdu Sister Cities Scholarship at CDUT

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students in Sichuan meeting provincial scholarship criteria. Applicants should demonstrate good academic performance at CDUT.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through CDUT following the Sichuan Provincial Scholarship notice. Submit materials via the CDUT application system.
scholarships.title: Sichuan Provincial Scholarship at CDUT

tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

name: HIT

scholarships.amount_text: Elite: 100% tuition waiver; First: 50% tuition waiver; Second: 30% tuition waiver; Third: 20% tuition waiver. Bachelor 4 years, Master 2-3 years, Doctoral 4 years.
documents: Language certificate HSK 4 210+ for Chinese-taught or IELTS 6.0+/TOEFL 80+ for English-taught
Physical examination record and non-criminal report
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health. Bachelor applicants hold high school diploma (under 25 for HIT Scholarship, under 30 otherwise) with HSK 4 210+ for Chinese-taught or IELTS 6.0+/TOEFL 80+ for English-taught programs and excellent academics.
scholarships.instructions: Take CSCA at csca.cn, complete the HIT online application at hit.at0086.cn/student, remit the fee (400 self-financed / 600 scholarship) and upload documents from Oct 1, 2025 to July 15, 2026. Paper materials are not accepted.
scholarships.title: HIT International Students Scholarship

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fee, accommodation fee, monthly stipend and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC Type A standards.
documents: Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CSC Bilateral Program requirements with HIT as first-choice institution. Applicants must meet degree, health and language criteria.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the Chinese Embassy or Consulate via campuschina.org selecting HIT as first priority, and complete the HIT online application. Do not apply for CSC and HIT scholarships simultaneously.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A) at HIT

tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Chinese-taught 20,000 RMB/year; English-taught 26,000 RMB/year; Duration 4-5 years.
Insurance: 800 RMB/year; Application fee self-financed 400 RMB, HIT Scholarship application 600 RMB (non-refundable).
Accommodation: 800-1,000 RMB/month/bed excluding utilities.
Master and PhD tuition varies by program; see the official Study at HIT program pages.

name: HEU

scholarships.amount_text: Bachelor: First full tuition + 1,500 RMB/month, Second full tuition, Third 50% tuition. Master: First full tuition + 2,000 RMB/month, Second full tuition, Third 50% tuition. Doctoral: First full tuition + 3,000 RMB/month, Second full tuition, Third 50% tuition. Degree students cover full standard length; visiting max 12 months.
documents: Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international degree, exchange and visiting students at HEU. Bachelor normally 25 and under, master 35 and under, doctoral 40 and under, with excellent academics, good morals and health.
scholarships.instructions: Apply at issp.hrbeu.edu.cn following the annual HEU Scholarship guideline. Talent-based 5,000 RMB one-time bachelor awards require no separate application.
scholarships.title: HEU Scholarship (Excellent Student Scholarship)

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, stipend and insurance per CSC Type A standards for Chinese-taught programs.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese applicants for Chinese-taught programs under CSC Type A cooperation agreements. Applicants apply through the Embassy and meet HEU admission criteria.
scholarships.instructions: Request a pre-admission notice at issp.hrbeu.edu.cn, then apply at studyinchina.csc.edu.cn selecting Type A with HEU as first choice. Follow HEU admission handbook timelines.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A) at HEU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free accommodation or allowance, living stipend 2,500 RMB/month for undergraduates, medical insurance 800 RMB/person/year. For Chinese Language undergraduate applicants only.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants for the HEU Chinese Language undergraduate program through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship. Applicants need qualifying HSK results and good academics.
scholarships.instructions: Find a recommending institution at chinese.cn selecting HEU as host, then complete the HEU application at issp.hrbeu.edu.cn. See chinesetest.cn for HSK details.
scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at HEU

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese Language program: 16,000 RMB/year; Other Chinese-taught programs: 17,000 RMB/year; English-taught programs: 22,000 RMB/year.
Application fee: 400 RMB/person; Medical insurance: 800 RMB/year; Residence permit: 800 RMB/year.
Accommodation: double-bed 400 RMB/month, single 800 RMB/month.
Master and doctoral tuition follows HEU yearly rates; see the official admission books.

name: NEFU

scholarships.amount_text: First-class: exempt tuition and housing fees; Second-class: exempt tuition; Third-class: 50% tuition reduction; Fourth-class: 30% tuition reduction. For Chinese-medium Bachelor and Master self-financed students; HSK 4 required.
documents: Study plan or research proposal at least 800 words
Two recommendation letters for graduate programs
Foreigner Physical Examination Form and HSK certificate
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese nationals in good health with excellent study performance. Open to self-financed applicants for Chinese-medium Bachelor and Master programs who have passed HSK 4; cannot combine with other scholarships.
scholarships.instructions: Apply online at istudy.nefu.edu.cn and submit the NEFU President Scholarship form with documents (application dates typically before April 30). Recipients may reapply yearly based on performance.
scholarships.title: NEFU President Scholarship (Freshman)

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance per CSC standards.
documents: Physical examination form and clearance certificate
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CSC requirements for NEFU programs. Applicants should have strong academics, good health and no criminal record.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via campuschina.org and complete the NEFU online application at istudy.nefu.edu.cn. Follow the SIEE Scholarships pages for program guidance.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Program at NEFU

scholarships.eligibility: International students from Eurasian countries meeting the Ministry-Province program criteria at NEFU. Applicants should demonstrate good academics and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through NEFU at istudy.nefu.edu.cn following the Eurasian Countries program notice. Contact SIEE@nefu.edu.cn for guidance.
scholarships.title: Scholarship Program for International Students from Eurasian Countries at NEFU

tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

name: HLJU

scholarships.amount_text: First Class: application fee, tuition and accommodation fees. Second Class: application fee and tuition. Third Class: application fee and 50% tuition reduction. Fourth Class: application fee and 10% tuition remission.
documents: Scholarship application form in Chinese or English
Academic transcripts and HSK certificate if any
CSCA Academic Proficiency Test score report
Study and research plan at least 500 words
Physical examination record and passport copy
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international applicants for HLJU Institute of International Culture and Education undergraduate programs (Chinese Language and Literature 4 years; International Economics and Trade 5 years). Applicants must be non-Chinese under 25 with high school diploma, CSCA test results and good grades.
scholarships.instructions: Email truthful materials to studyathlju@hotmail.com before June 5. Admission notices and JW202 forms are sent in early July; yearly review is required to renew.
scholarships.title: HLJU University Scholarship (International Culture and Education)

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fees, accommodation fees, living expenses and comprehensive medical insurance for Undergraduate, Master and Doctoral students (2026-2029).
documents: Non-criminal record or commitment letter and CSCA form for undergraduates
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students from Eurasian countries and youth worldwide for study in Heilongjiang. Applicants must meet degree, health and language requirements for the chosen level.
scholarships.instructions: Apply to HLJU following the Ministry-Province Eurasian Program guide and email materials to studyathlju@hotmail.com. Contact the International Student Admission Office for review steps.
scholarships.title: Ministry-Province Eurasian Program Scholarship at HLJU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation, stipend and insurance per CSC High Level and Silk Road program standards.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CSC requirements for HLJU programs. Applicants should have excellent academics and meet program language criteria.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via campuschina.org under the CSC High Level or Silk Road track and complete HLJU procedures. Follow the HLJU Scholarship pages for details.
scholarships.title: CSC Scholarship (High Level / Silk Road) at HLJU

tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

name: Xi'an Jiaotong University

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition fee waiver, free on-campus dormitory accommodation, monthly living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC standards.
documents: Physical examination form and supervisor acceptance for postgraduates
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting XJTU admission and CSC requirements. Undergraduate, master and doctoral applicants must satisfy degree, age and language criteria and pass qualification review at registration.
scholarships.instructions: Apply at campuschina.org (XJTU agency 10698, Type B for University Program) and complete the XJTU application at isso.xjtu.edu.cn/recruit/login. Monitor the system and email for review and tuition-payment notices.
scholarships.title: CSC Chinese Government Scholarship at XJTU

scholarships.amount_text: Bachelor 15,000 RMB/year; Master 20,000 RMB/year; PhD 25,000 RMB/year; non-degree 6 months+ 1,000 RMB/month. XJTU covers 100% tuition for Master and PhD students. Annual review required.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of Belt and Road countries. Bachelor need high school certificate under 25; master need bachelor under 35; doctoral need master under 40; non-degree under 45. HSK 4+ required; no other scholarship held.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the application online directly to XJTU at isso.xjtu.edu.cn. Bachelor and non-degree apply Mar 1 to June 30 (deadline June 30); master and PhD apply Nov to Mar (deadline Apr 15).
scholarships.title: XJTU-Xi'an City Government Belt and Road Scholarship

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted international postgraduate students at XJTU. Applicants should have excellent academics and meet program entry requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the XJTU International Student Application System. The Freshman Scholarship applies to the first year and is awarded on comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.title: XJTU International Freshman Scholarship (Postgraduate)

tuition_info:
Application fee: self-sponsored 500 RMB, scholarship programs 800 RMB (non-refundable).
Accommodation: 8,000-19,000 RMB/year depending on campus and room type; booked online and arranged by the university.
Tuition varies by program and teaching language; see the official XJTU International Postgraduate Programs 2026 fee standard.
Contact adm-sie@xjtu.edu.cn for program-specific tuition confirmation.

name: NPU

scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship covers tuition, dormitory/accommodation subsidy, stipend Master 3,000 / Doctoral 3,500 RMB/month, and medical insurance. Partial covers one or some items. NPU agency 10699, Type B, Master and PhD only.
documents: Non-criminal record and Physical Examination Form
Supervisor acceptance letter for required schools
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens under 30 by Sept 1, 2026 holding a bachelor degree with average 75%+ (80%+ for CSC). Applicants need qualifying Chinese or English proficiency and must pass material review and interview.
scholarships.instructions: Create an account at admission.nwpu.edu.cn, complete the application and psychological evaluation, pay 600 RMB fee, and upload documents by Feb 28, 2026 for CSC Type B. Also submit the CSC form at campuschina.org; batches run Nov 1, 2025 to Apr 30, 2026.
scholarships.title: CSC University Program (Type B) at NPU

scholarships.amount_text: Multi-type freshman awards including tuition waivers and living allowances (e.g. undergraduate allowance standards and partial tuition exemptions). Only one government/NPU scholarship may be held.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted international students across Bachelor, Master and PhD levels at NPU. Selection is merit-based with early applicants prioritized; pre-admitted students pay a 3,000 RMB deposit refundable after registration.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the NPU online portal at admission.nwpu.edu.cn. Undergraduate batches: Nov 1, 2025-Jan 15, 2026 and later batches; Master batches through Apr 30, 2026. Results arrive by registered email.
scholarships.title: NPU President Scholarship

scholarships.amount_text: Three levels; First level exempts tuition and accommodation with living allowances (e.g. graduates 1,500 RMB/month x12, PhD higher). Freshman scholarship for first academic year only.
scholarships.eligibility: International freshman applicants to NPU. Master applicants hold a bachelor degree and are under 30; undergraduate and PhD criteria follow program guides. Only one scholarship may be held.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the NPU admission portal in the Undergraduate or Master windows (first undergraduate batch Nov 1, 2025-Jan 15, 2026). Scholarship review follows admission batches.
scholarships.title: Xi'an City Belt and Road Scholarship at NPU

tuition_info:
Bachelor: Chinese-medium 22,000 / English-medium 25,000 RMB/year.
Master: Chinese-medium 30,000 / English-medium 33,000 RMB/year; PhD: Chinese-medium 38,000 / English-medium 42,000 RMB/year.
Foundation: one-year 25,000 RMB/year, one-semester 15,000 RMB/semester; Application 600 RMB; Insurance 800/1,000 RMB/year.
Accommodation: triple 5,400; double 7,200/9,000; single 10,800 RMB/year.

name: NWAFU

scholarships.amount_text: Full: tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation, medical insurance, monthly stipend Doctoral 3,500 / Master 3,000 / Undergraduate 2,500 RMB/month. Partial First: tuition + accommodation + insurance. Partial Second: 50% tuition waiver.
documents: Two expert recommendation letters for Master/PhD
Supervisor acceptance for Master/PhD and language certificate
Physical examination form and police clearance
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with strong academics and no other scholarships. Doctoral need master degree under 35; master need bachelor under 30; bachelor need high school under 25. Chinese-taught need HSK 4+; English-taught need IELTS 5.5+/TOEFL 79+.
scholarships.instructions: Log in to the NWAFU International Student Application System, complete the form and upload documents before May 31, 2026. Colleges evaluate academics and the university approves the final list with annual review.
scholarships.title: Northwest A&F University International Student Scholarship 2026

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation, insurance and living stipend per CSC standards. NWAFU CSC Type B code 10712.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese Master and Doctoral applicants meeting CSC University Program requirements at NWAFU. Applicants must meet degree, age, language and health criteria.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC portal studyinchina.csc.edu.cn (Type B, code 10712) before Feb 28, 2026, and complete the NWAFU application at nwsuaf.17gz.org. Bilateral Type A applicants consult their dispatching department.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (University Program) at NWAFU

tuition_info:
Chinese Language Programs: 12,800 RMB/year; Undergraduate Chinese-taught: 18,000 RMB/year.
Master: Chinese Social Sciences 19,600 / Natural Sciences 22,000 RMB/year; English-taught 26,000 RMB/year.
Doctoral: Chinese Social Sciences 23,600 / Natural Sciences 26,000 RMB/year; English-taught 30,000 RMB/year.
Application fee 400 RMB (non-refundable); Insurance 800 RMB/year; Accommodation about 500 RMB/month.
